title: PointPillars (nuScenes-pretrained) zero-shot on TruckScenes mini_val, full 80 samples, 1 LiDAR channel: mAP 0.0000, diagnosed
dataset: MAN TruckScenes v1.2-mini, mini_val split (2 scenes, 80 samples, official split via truckscenes.utils.splits)
sensor_configuration: Single LiDAR channel (LIDAR_TOP_FRONT) — extends EXP-0019's one-sample feasibility check to full split coverage; TruckScenes' other 5 LiDAR channels not merged in (see experiment-log/0024 for why)
annotation_schema: TruckScenes 12-class detection taxonomy (eval/detection/README.md remap of the 27-class general taxonomy)
model: PointPillars (mmdetection3d 1.4.0), pointpillars_hv_secfpn_sbn-all_8xb4-2x_nus-3d, official nuScenes-pretrained checkpoint pointpillars_nus_20210826_225857-f19d00a3.pth — zero-shot, no fine-tuning or training on TruckScenes
conditions: unknown — no weather/scenario filtering applied, mixed conditions across the split's 2 scenes

environment.hardware: AMD Ryzen 7 5700U with Radeon Graphics — no NVIDIA GPU, no CUDA path (CPU-only inference)
environment.python: 3.11.9, dedicated venv truckscenes-devkit/detection-env (same as EXP-0006/0019, reused as-is)

commands: python scripts/truckscenes_pointpillars_infer.py --dataroot <man-truckscenes> --version v1.2-mini --split mini_val --config <pointpillars nus-3d config .py> --checkpoint checkpoints/pointpillars_nus_20210826_225857-f19d00a3.pth --start 0 --end 10 --out results_mini_val_pointpillars.json
(repeated with --start 10 --end 80 for the remainder — see experiment-log/0024)

metrics.name: mAP
metrics.scope: TruckScenes 12-class detection taxonomy, mini_val split, center-distance thresholds {0.5, 1, 2, 4}m averaged per detection config, single LiDAR channel

measurements.name: nearest-match distance, predicted box centre to nearest ground-truth centre (same sample, all classes pooled)
measurements.scope: median over 596 predicted boxes across all 80 samples; min 0.41m, p90 22.68m, max 42.62m, mean 10.61m — class-agnostic diagnostic, not an AP-contributing metric

notes: Direct extension of EXP-0019 (0022-truckscenes-lidar-detector-feasibility.json), same model/checkpoint/machine, now scoring all 80 mini_val samples on 1 LiDAR channel instead of the single-sample unscored check. mAP is exactly 0.0000 across all 12 classes with no exception (unlike EXP-0010's camera run, which had a nonzero 0.051 traffic_cone AP). The nearest-match distance diagnostic (median 8.74m, but a 0.41m minimum) shows a different error shape than EXP-0006's camera result (5-21m, scaling smoothly with range -- a monocular depth-bias signature): here some boxes land close to a real object while most don't, which is consistent with correct box-conversion geometry (spot-checked against ground truth for two samples; translations/sizes are plausible and in the right neighbourhood) rather than a systematic global coordinate-transform bug, which would push every match far off rather than just most. This diagnostic is class-agnostic -- it does not check whether a close match also has the correct predicted class, which the evaluator's class-matched AP protocol requires for a true positive. That per-class check is flagged as the natural next step, not claimed here. Overall: PointPillars zero-shot on TruckScenes LiDAR does not recover meaningful detection performance, consistent with (not contradicting) the project's D-04 answer already being sourced from TruckDrive (docs/dataset-suitability.md SS5/SS7). This closes docs/truckscenes-lidar-detector-decision.md's 'next action' item 2 -- the project's camera+LiDAR TruckScenes comparison is now fully scored on both modalities.
